article.title: Cuba, Gaza, and the human cost of imperial thirst
article.author: Editor
article.content: In Gaza, thousands of children have been killed amid the genocide that’s being imposed by Israel with total impunity. Thousands of them are unaccounted for and buried beneath the rubble. In Cuba, millions of people have survived for years amid blackouts, shortages, difficulties accessing medicines, fuel scarcity, and a profound economic crisis imposed upon them by the United States. The post Cuba, Gaza, and the human cost of imperial thirst appeared first on MR Online .
